AI Video Editor Background Changer — Initial Release

- Seamlessly remove and replace video backgrounds using AI, no green screen needed.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB in MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM formats.
- Automatic background replacement: just describe the scene you want (e.g. “home office”) and receive a rendered MP4 in 30–60 seconds.
- Easy setup: instant connection to cloud processing, with 100 free credits for new users.
- Handles user prompts for exporting, credits, status, and uploads via natural language.
- Built-in error handling, batch processing, and iterative editing support.
